caption:
Not sure which colors go where? You don't have to be. Start with the numbers. 🍂

The autumn book opens with 10 color-by-number pages for grown-ups (and 15 for the kids), so you can warm up first. Then you'll pick from 65 fall scenes in clean line art: pumpkins, falling leaves, acorns, a rocking chair on the porch.

It's an 80-page print-ready PDF plus PNG files, US Letter. Hit print. It fits.
